title: Very-dry Mualem conductivity arithmetic reconciliation
question: Is the O05 tight-K refinement blocker caused by floating-point cancellation in the algebraic evaluation of the Mualem conductivity bracket rather than by irreducible constitutive curvature?
tests: Compare standard-double and stable-double evaluations over the AHL lookup domain for B01, B12, O05 and O14.
Demonstrate convergence of linear log(K) interpolation under the preregistered F-AHL10B tolerances when the stable algebraic evaluation is used as the table-construction oracle.
Do not change the runtime Richards reference provider in this work unit.

acceptance.normal_domain_agreement: Differences must remain negligible where cancellation is not active.
acceptance.dry_end_diagnosis: Stable evaluation must remove the refinement floor responsible for O05 BUILD_FAIL.
